sentence: [This site's July birth flower page](/july-birth-flower/) runs into a similar naming mix-up from a different angle: the plant most guides call Egypt's sacred lotus is actually a water lily, only distantly related to a true lotus.

April's birth flower raises a comparable need to distinguish the evidence: [this site's April birth flower page](/april-birth-flower/) describes sweet-pea seed effects studied in experimental animals, separately from the human famine illness caused by grass pea.
